我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的顾问试图教育当地居民，以提高他们的科技水平，但这项任务遇到了一些挫折。许多[pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]拒绝和我们接触，甚至他们中的好学者，都对我们的科学家持怀疑和厌恶的态度。

这种排外情绪耽误了我们的日程表。教育[pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]比我们预料的要花费更多时间。
texts.en:
Our advisors on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] are having trouble working with the local inhabitants in their mission to bring them up to a higher level of technology. Many [pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to have anything to do with us, and even those among them who are most eager to learn look upon our scientists with suspicion and disgust.

This xenophobia has unfortunately upset our timetables. Teaching the [pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will take longer than expected.
